newsitem.title: USA: Woman named to head Carnegie think tank.
newsitem.headline: Woman named to head Carnegie think tank.

text.p: Jessica Tuchman Mathews, a senior fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations, was named Thursday to head the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, an influential U.S. think tank.

Mathews, 51, will succeed Morton Abramowitz, a former U.S. ambassador who announced last November his plans to leave the position he has held for the past five years. Mathews takes over as president in May.

Mathews, who is also a Washington Post columnist, was a deputy to the Undersecretary of State for global affairs in 1993 and from 1982 to 1993 she helped found and served as vice president of the World Resources Institute, a centre for policy research.
